A basic explanation of +/- pts. Over under, etc.

I'll keep it simple for the newbies. Here's an example of how it'll work -

Player/Better A - Bet $1 - on team A (New York for example)

B bet 10 - a

C bet 50 b

D bet 4 a

E bet 15 b

F bet 20 b

G bet 10 a

H bet .50 b

I bet 5 a

J bet 80 a

A team total bet: $110

B team total bet: $85.5

A team wins (New York wins)

Player A receives initial bet amount + equal distribution of other team's total bet amount. I calculate this by dividing 85.5 (B team's total bet amount) by 110 (team A's bet amount) = 0.777272727. Then I multiply Player A's bet amount by this number. $1 x 0.777272727 = 0.77727272 = $0.77 (rounded down). This is player A's profit. Player A receives $0.77 plus original bet amount for a total of $1.77

Player B receives - $10 x 0.777272727 = $7.77 + $10 = $17.77

D - $4 x 0.777272727 = 3.109090908 = $3.10 +$4 = $7.10

G - $10 x 0.777272727 = $7.77 + $10 = 17.77

I - $5 x 0.777272727 = 3.886363635 = $3.88 + $5 = $8.88

J – $80 x 0.777272727 = $62.18181816 = $62.18 + $80 = $142.18

Total paid - $0.77 + $7.77 + $3.10 + $7.77 + $3.88 + $62.18 === $85.47 (I keep the 3 pennies, for my hard work)

**Daily Devotional**

**March 24**

*3 Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;4 And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead: (Romans 1:3-4 KJV)*

God’s Son Jesus Christ, is not only the Son of God (Matthew 1:23), but is our Lord and Savior. The fact that the Son of God came to this earth, and gave Himself to die on the cross for us, so that we might be made the righteousness of Him (Ephesians 4:24), and be reconciled to God the Father (John 17:3), makes the Christian religion different from all other religions. Since Jesus was raised from the dead to never die again (Matthew 28:6), means that the founder of our faith is alive, unlike the founder of all the other religions of the world. Being a seed of David made Jesus fulfill many Old Testament Scriptures.

After Jesus rose from the grave, three days after His crucifixion, He was seen by many believers (Acts 1:3). As many as 500 at one time saw Jesus after His resurrection (1 Corinthians 15:6), and He talked and taught His disciples for 40 days before ascending into Heaven to sit at the right hand of the Father (Mark 16:19). What a good God we have to give us His own Son to bear our sins, and bring us back into fellowship with Him, which is what everlasting life is (John 17:3). It is not enough to know about Jesus, and the Father, but you must have a close, personal, relationship with them, so that Jesus will never say “I never knew you” at His return (Matthew 7:23). Praise God for saving us by grace - the “Good News” of the Gospel.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
